text:
olivia: Quick heads up: launching a limited preview for A900-Turbo dedicated micro-pools in ap-northeast-3 (Kyoto) and sa-west-1 (Mexico City). Targeting low-latency high-qps inference for regional customers. Reservation window opens 2026-04-20 02:00 UTC via Console + API. :sparkles:
raj: Nice. Is this a new physical SKU or a tuned variant? Any perf numbers?
sophie: It's a tuned variant (A900-T) with trimmed compute slices and optimized memory interconnect for inference. Early perf: p50 ~45ms for 4k context int8 on a 2-unit reservation, p95 ~120ms. We'll publish full bench later.
olivia: SLA: 99.85% reserved availability during preview. Burst policy: up to 10% of pool for 5m windows, twice/day. Bursts subject to capacity steering while we calibrate.
deploy-bot: rollout plan: preview -> monitored GA. Canary starts 2026-04-20 02:00 UTC.
capacity-bot: initial allocation: ap-northeast-3 = 30 units (6 clusters), sa-west-1 = 20 units (5 clusters). Preview quotas limited to 6 units/org.
raj: How do we reserve via API?
sophie: API example (internal):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/dedicated/reservations \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"region":"ap-northeast-3","gpu_type":"a900-turbo","units":2,"term_months":3}'
```

olivia: Migration notes: existing A900-Standard customers can request a migration trial. We'll offer a 45-day overlap and prorated credits if you convert. Fill the migration form: https://intra.redwood.io/dedicated/migrate-a900t
sre: For latency-sensitive workloads enable per-request affinity and small-batch packing. Avoid auto-batching > 64 tokens for tail latency. We'll post a tuning doc in #eng-latency.
billing: Preview reservations use SKU a900-t.preview and are not billed until conversion or GA opt-in. Conversions will be offered with prorated credits for active commitments. Contact billing@redwood.com for quotes.
product-team: Note to partners: CS kits and one-pagers will be available by EOD. Please don't promise GA dates yet.
raj: Any region-specific caveats for Mexico City? network/backhaul?
olivia: Yes: sa-west-1 has limited cross-region burst capacity during preview to protect edge backhaul. Expect slightly stricter burst throttles for first 72h.
capacity-bot: Quota expansion requests: use Console > Support > Dedicated quotas. Typical turnaround 48-72h for preview increases.
olivia: I'll run a 30m AMA in #dedicated tomorrow 11:00 JST to walk through details. Ping me if you want a slot for partner demos. :calendar:
